hayden: at the time, `import { type x }` when TS compiles turns into `import { }` leaving a potential side effect import or at the very least a waste of a line. `import type` was removed entirely during compilation. not sure if that's still the case, especially with all the different typescript compilers out there now (ts-rust, ts7 in go, scriptc, bun build --compile) but at the time there was a solid reason.
